parole.significato: seriema (New World terrestrial bird of family Cariamidae)
parole.testo: Transliteration of the scientific name Cariama, of Tupian origin (from Old Tupi saria (“crest”)).

parole.significato: tanager (colorful passerine bird of genus Tangara or more generally of family Thraupidae, native to the Neotropics)
parole.testo: Transliteration of the scientific name of the genus Tangara, of Tupian origin.
